preconditions.description: The number of queries t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The order of the graph n must be between 1 and 1,000.
Each vertex number ai and bi must be between 1 and 10^16, and they must be distinct.
Both vertex numbers ai and bi must be less than or equal to the number of vertices in the graph D(n).

postconditions.description: The output must be the length of the shortest path between vertices ai and bi.
